pages.title: The Listener Becomes the Phantom
body: Question: Who is The Phantom: a character we tell stories about, or a state of mind the listener becomes?
Discovery: The Locksmith is not about breaking in. It is about becoming someone who can build anything.
Decision: Every track will represent a stage in the transformation from ordinary to extraordinary.
THIS CHANGED EVERYTHING
• Track titles
• Track purposes
• The emotional arc
• The album artwork concept
• How we talk about the album
Why it matters: When someone presses play, they do not just listen. They step into a different identity.

"We're not macking music for hackers.
We're making music for builders." - AG

pages.title: Why We Built Tempo First
body: Question: What is the smallest useful interface for protecting attention?
Discovery: Tempo taught us that workflow tools should remove negotiation, not add dashboards.
Breakthrough: A focused ritual can become infrastructure for better work.
I'm just trying to observe whether this works or not and right now it looks like not is winning.

pages.title: Why the Notebook Exists
body: Question: How do we show the thinking that led to the commits, not merely the commits themselves?
Discovery: The notebook is not a recap. It is the place where motives, dead ends, and decisions remain visible.
Decision: Publish entries from the same semantic document source used by the authoring workspace.
Why it matters: Artifacts feel more human when the reader can see the path that shaped them.

pages.title: From Friction to Flow
body: Spark: Friction is not always bad; unchosen friction is the problem.
Why it matters: Every removed decision gives attention back to the work that matters.
Margin note: Beautiful constraints are a kindness to future focus.

pages.title: Continuo Isn’t Another Productivity App
body: Productivity apps often preserve motion instead of meaning.
Decision: Continuo should help people continue the right work, not merely track more work.
“The tool is successful when the user returns to the craft faster.”

pages.title: Cold Boot Defines the Identity
body: Spark: The first sound should feel like a system waking up and remembering its purpose.
Decision: Cold Boot becomes the threshold: before it, potential; after it, commitment.
Identity lands better when it is introduced as a ritual instead of an explanation.
